issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 1.3.1, Success Criterion 4.1.2 (critical severity)]:
aria-hidden="true" must not be present on the document body.

Element: <body aria-hidden="true">

Fix any of the following:
• aria-hidden=true should not be present on the document body

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-hidden-body?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 A, Success Criterion 4.1.2 (serious severity)]:
ARIA hidden element must not be focusable or contain focusable elements.

Element: <body aria-hidden="true">

Fix all of the following:
• Focusable content should have tabindex="-1" or be removed from the DOM

Help: https://dequeuniversity.com/rules/axe/4.11/aria-hidden-focus?application=axeAPI

issue on [/] - [WCAG 2.0 AA, Success Criterion 1.4.4 (serious severity)]:
Users with visual impairments must be able to zoom in on text to at least 200%.

Element: <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, user-scalable=no">

Fix all of the following:
• The user-scalable attribute "no" must be a number outside the range of -1 and +1, or "device-width" or "device-height" or "yes".

Help: https://www.w3.org/WAI/standards-guidelines/act/rules/b4f0c3/proposed/
